name: Super-Superfiring Turret Positions (Z/F/G/H/I)
author: RTW3 Mod Manager
description: Adds five selectable raised turret positions: Z, F, G, H and I. Requires Historical and Paper Hulls (Large Hulls) and a restart through Play with mods. RTW3 stores raised/not-raised as a boolean, so these add mount positions but do not create a separately modeled third height. Existing B, V and X behavior is preserved.
